name: video-player
title: VideoPlayer
description: Play, pause, and scrub branded video with DS chrome. Product demos and embedded media.

discovery.name: VideoPlayer
discovery.description: Play, pause, and scrub branded video with DS chrome. Product demos and embedded media.

configurables.what: Starts playback when the player activates.
configurables.how: false by default. true only with muted (autoplay policies); sets data-video-muted when autoplay is on.
true for autoplay heroes; false when sound is intentional. Default: false.

gotchas.note: videoId is required (provider id). customer/placeholder optional. Behavior is driven by data-video-* attributes + motion/controller hooks.
Provide a real title/placeholder for the media region; do not autoplay with sound.

agent.usage:
import { VideoPlayer } from '@/components/atoms/VideoPlayer';

<VideoPlayer videoId="abc123" muted autoplay={false} placeholder="/poster.jpg" />
